steps.title: Send a table through the pass
steps.prompt: Put the stages of sending one table's course through the pass in order, from the ticket to the seat. One stage does not belong.
steps: Read the new ticket to the line as it arrives, so every station can get ready
Wait until the table is ready for the course, the soup bowls cleared and nobody away
Fire the course, the slowest dish first and the quicker ones after, timed to land together
Call for the table's plates and gather them at the pass as they come up
Check every plate against the ticket, and the flagged allergy plate with the kitchen as well
Call hands, and give the plates to servers who know the table and its seat numbers
Send each plate to its seat by number, the flagged plate carried alone and never stacked
steps.distractor: Fire the whole table's mains the moment the ticket arrives, before the starters have gone
steps.why: The line hears the ticket early so it can prepare, but nothing is fired until the table is ready, and the slowest dish goes first so every plate lands at once. Each plate is checked hot, right and clean before hands are called, and the flagged allergy plate, checked with the kitchen, travels alone.
